parsed.rationale: All four records are `type-alias-object` kinds with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning the structural signal is limited to the alias declaration shape itself rather than any shared logic or members. `LargeNowPlayingWidgetEntryView`, `MediumNowPlayingWidgetEntryView`, `SmallNowPlayingWidgetEntryView`, and `Header` are intentionally distinct widget view aliases that correspond to different WidgetKit size families and a separate header component — their coincidental structural identity as type aliases does not indicate duplicated behaviour. Collapsing them into a single type would destroy the semantic distinction between Small, Medium, and Large widget entry points that WidgetKit requires. No restraint markers are present, but the domain concepts are unrelated enough that the overlap is purely structural.
